core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gafar corresponds to the Arabic form غَفّار (Arabic root غ ف ر (gh-f-r); غَفّار (Ghaffār)). Its core sense is forgiving, most generous. Gafar is a South Asian spelling of Arabic غفار (Ghaffār) 'most forgiving, ever-forgiving', an intensive adjective from the root غ ف ر (gh-f-r) 'to forgive'. It is also a divine name in Islamic tradition. The source gave the non-standard عَفّار as the Arabic form and glossed it 'carrier of a heavy burden' (that sense belongs to حمّال/حمال), both of which were corrected.
